FD255: CLOEXEC bit present in supplied flags, normally closes at successful exec; not a future table guarantee
FIRST_EXEC: Nominated Bash already-running operator shell -> prospective127 prlimit; actual shell callsite not supplied. Bash FD255 internal descriptor is not assumed to protect every other handle.
